summary: The image build failed while copying files into the runtime stage because the runner's disk was full. Disk use was already 96% before the build, and the build context was over 1 GB.

likely_causes.cause: The runner ran out of disk space during the multi-stage Docker build.

evidence.quote: #12 ERROR: failed to copy files: copy file range failed: no space left on device

likely_causes.cause: A very large build context (1.21 GB) used much of the remaining space; a .dockerignore may be missing entries.

next_checks: Check which directories are sent in the build context and extend .dockerignore.
Free disk space before the build, for example by pruning unused Docker data.
